newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to buy heavy steers into intervention stores.
newsitem.headline: EU to buy heavy steers into intervention stores.

text.p: The European Commission will open a special programme allowing steers over the weight limit to be bought into intervention stores during September, a European Union official said on Thursday.
"The amendment to the regulation was approved by the EU's sugar management committee on Wednesday and has still to be formally adopted by the Commission," the official said.

Farmers, who were unable to sell steers on the open market because of mad cow disease, or Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE), will now be able to sell animals over the 390 kilogram weight limit into intervention stores at the 390 kg price rate.
The measure will mainly benefit Irish farmers who have been badly hit by the collapse in their export markets due to BSE. --Chris White, Brussels Bureau +322 287 6830
